body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented its 12cm-thick mono laser printer ‘ML-1631K’ dubbed as ‘Swan’ during KES 2007. Designed as a high-end printer matching with modern office environment, the Swan can print out up to sixteen A4 pages within 1 minute. Measuring 6.4kg weight, it features high-speed USB 2.0 interface and low 45db noise level.
